choices.why: Image 6 is a low, beige, three-seat sofa with track arms and dark legs, a clean Japandi shape that fits the long right wall facing the balcony door.
A natural jute rug at 160 x 230 cm is large enough to sit under the sofa and coffee table and matches the warm, neutral palette.
A round wood coffee table at 110 cm diameter and 42 cm high suits the space in front of the sofa and echoes the wood tones of the floor.
A tall rice paper floor lamp gives the soft lantern glow the user asked for and suits the corner beside the sofa.
The ZZ plant is a full, large green plant with neutral foliage that fills the corner by the balcony glass and adds the calm, natural accent the room needs.
